name: Selene Mene
source: Selene is a beautiful woman whom I've met during Yule celebration. If what she said was true she is a Triple Goddess and a wife of a Horned God. She wonders our earth in a hope to find a champion who would be able to become the avatar for her husband. But who knows, maybe she just made it all up?
